en: A sepia-toned vintage street scene titled "Riga Theaterboulevard." It shows a broad cobblestone boulevard with early electric trams, horse‑drawn carriages, and pedestrians. Multi‑story classical buildings line both sides of the street, including a domed structure on the right. Trees and a large building appear in the background, suggesting a central urban avenue near a theater district.
